summary: Hilton Grand Vacations Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a routine amendment to an existing warehouse credit facility. On May 20, 2026, subsidiary Hilton Grand Vacations Trust I LLC entered into Omnibus Amendment No. 5, increasing the facility size from $850M to $1B, extending the revolving period to May 2028, and adding collateral eligibility for certain timeshare loans. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return occurred. The filing is a standard debt financing arrangement in the ordinary course of business. No deal terms apply.
